layers.name: Vanilla 1.12
layers.role: Classic content Forever kept unchanged; reference to restore a row the base lost.

layers.name: Server world
layers.role: The world as built: the core's release database and its update files, replayed.

layers.name: Season of Discovery era
layers.role: Rows for ids the Forever client carries from the Classic Era client.

layers.name: Blizzard's client and hotfixes
layers.role: Decides what exists; wins every field the client holds.

layers.name: Live recordings
layers.role: What players' addons recorded on live Forever: wins server-held facts when witnessed.

layers.name: Reviewed corrections
layers.role: A person's decision, with a reason.

sources.name: Core release database and update files
sources.credit: TrinityCore and its WoW Forever fork (https://github.com/Karrz1/TrinityCore), GPL-2.0 or later.

sources.name: Karrz's WoW Forever releases
sources.credit: TrinityCore and its WoW Forever fork by Karrz (https://github.com/Karrz1/Karrz-playerbots-wow-forever), GPL-2.0 or later.
sources.note: The line the core is built from: its releases carry the core's update files. The pin shows when a new release is out; it reaches the world once the core you replay has taken it in.

sources.name: EmuForever DatabaseForever
sources.note: The core's release database plus generated NPC templates and spawns: never a second witness beside the core.

sources.name: Classic Era client tables
sources.note: Ids only: which Forever ids come from the Classic Era client (Season of Discovery included).

sources.name: EG Link
sources.credit: Data from Efficient Games (https://efficient.games), licensed under CC BY 4.0.

sources.name: Icy Veins WoW Forever database
sources.note: Holds EG Link's rows (all of its quest giver and trainer pairs, 98 % of its vendor pairs, 2026-11-12): the same witness group as EG Link.

sources.name: QuestieDB
sources.credit: QuestieDB (https://github.com/Questie/QuestieDB), with players' QuestieTrace recordings, GPL-3.0.
sources.note: Read: its Forever corrections (players' traces, the generated delta, hand fixes). Its converted Classic base is not read: it says what Classic had. Its generated delta is built from Wowhead's pages: no second witness beside Wowhead.

sources.name: NorgannonDB
sources.credit: NorgannonDB by Maro (https://github.com/zmarotrix/NorgannonDB), GPL-3.0, with QuestieDB, pfQuest and DungeonJournal as its NOTICE lists.
sources.note: Compiled from QuestieDB, pfQuest, cmangos classic-db and DungeonJournal: never a second witness beside any of them. Its DungeonJournal data is published under NorgannonDB's own licence and credit (its author's permission, as its NOTICE says).

sources.name: RestedXP guides (RXPGuides)
sources.note: A levelling guide written by hand, not a recording. Non-commercial and share-alike: its rows may not go into a GPL data repository, so it only counts as a witness. Read: the steps that name one NPC by id and accept or turn in a quest the Classic Era client (Season of Discovery included) does not have.

sources.name: AtlasLoot Classic Forever
sources.note: Private until the addon's licence text is checked for "or any later version".

sources.name: Forever Dungeon Journal
sources.note: The addon read by itself: private until its licence is checked. (NorgannonDB carries a copy with its author's permission.)

sources.name: Wowhead Forever tooltips
sources.note: Names a thing and tags Season of Discovery leftovers. It does not decide what exists: the client's tables do.
